description_target.target_text: detect 6x6 hexagon circles by color; determine blockers (colors at missing hex positions); topological sort (unblocked first); output 6-wide vertical stack of complete hexagon outlines

racket_target.raw_code:
(rule!
 ;; Overlapping rings all share one 6x6 stencil (12 cells). Each
 ;; color's visible cells anchor its stencil copy; stencil cells it is
 ;; MISSING are hidden under rings lying on top. Order the colors so
 ;; every ring comes after the rings covering it (topmost first), then
 ;; print each ring complete in its own 6x6 tile, stacked vertically.
 (lambda (g)
   (let ()
     (define bg (mode g 0))
     (define stencil
       (list (list 0 2) (list 0 3) (list 1 1) (list 1 4) (list 2 0)
             (list 2 5) (list 3 0) (list 3 5) (list 4 1) (list 4 4)
             (list 5 2) (list 5 3)))
     (define (anchor-of cells)  ;; stencil offset covering every cell
       (let ((bb (bbox-of-cells cells)))
         (and (<= (- (third bb) (first bb)) 5)
              (<= (- (fourth bb) (second bb)) 5)
              (find-first
               (lambda (t)
                 (all? (lambda (cell)
                         (member (list (- (first cell) (first t))
                                       (- (second cell) (second t)))
                                 stencil))
                       cells))
               (for*/list ((tr (range (max 0 (- (third bb) 5))
                                      (+ (first bb) 1)))
                           (tc (range (max 0 (- (fourth bb) 5))
                                      (+ (second bb) 1))))
                 (list tr tc))))))
     (define circles  ;; (color blockers) per ring color found
       (filter (lambda (x) x)
               (map (lambda (col)
                      (let ((cells (find-color g col)))
                        (and (>= (length cells) 4)
                             (let ((t (anchor-of cells)))
                               (and t
                                    (let* ((rel (map (lambda (cl)
                                                       (list (- (first cl)
                                                                (first t))
                                                             (- (second cl)
                                                                (second t))))
                                                     cells))
                                           (hidden
                                            (filter
                                             (lambda (pos)
                                               (and (not (member pos rel))
                                                    (in-bounds?
                                                     (+ (first pos)
                                                        (first t))
                                                     (+ (second pos)
                                                        (second t))
                                                     h w)))
                                             stencil)))
                                      (list col
                                            (remove-duplicates
                                             (filter
                                              (lambda (v)
                                                (and (not (= v bg))
                                                     (not (= v col))))
                                              (map (lambda (pos)
                                                     (at g
                                                         (+ (first pos)
                                                            (first t))
                                                         (+ (second pos)
                                                            (second t))))
                                                   hidden))))))))))
                    (filter (lambda (c) (not (= c bg))) (grid-colors g)))))
     (define ring-colors (map first circles))
     (define (covered-by col)  ;; ring colors sitting on top of col
       (filter (lambda (b) (member? b ring-colors))
               (second (find (lambda (ci) (= (first ci) col)) circles))))
     (define order  ;; topmost ring first, base ring last
       (let loop ((rem ring-colors) (acc (list)))
         (if (null? rem)
             (reverse acc)
             (let ((next (find-first
                          (lambda (c)
                            (all? (lambda (b) (member? b acc))
                                  (covered-by c)))
                          rem)))
               (if next
                   (loop (remove next rem) (cons next acc))
                   (loop (rest rem) (cons (first rem) acc)))))))
     (for/fold ((out (empty-grid (* (length order) 6) 6 bg)))
               ((i (range 0 (length order))))
       (paint-cells out
                    (map (lambda (pos) (list (+ (first pos) (* i 6))
                                             (second pos)))
                         stencil)
                    (nth order i))))))
